dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Complex interlocking 'C' and 'O' shaped light-colored markings on the dorsal surface characterized by jagged, high-contrast perimeters with an abrupt gradient shift from dark gray exterior to cream interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, isolated high-intensity cream-colored blobs localized on the mid-lateral and posterior regions, exhibiting uniform pixel concentration without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary dorsal annular structures form a prominent obtuse scalene triangle; subordinate lateral blobs form an irregular linear alignment parallel to the mid-body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible radial vibrissae array on the muzzle and a single high-intensity specular reflection point within the dark ocular aperture.
